scope: October 2026 Lean-coverage and correction edition: listed statement, display, proof and passage changes with their correction items and Lean coverage register items; locations, statement bodies, proof passages and article hashes recomputed; retained evidence unchanged.

The preprint citation command gains a starred form, \preprintcite*, that omits the authors right after the sentence names them (M40, R-A-16); the unstarred form prints the same text as before, so no mathematical statement changes.

New full-rank calibration: for the Euclidean quadratic, the coverage proves compact positive sublevels, the unique minimizer, and all certificate conditions with W=I, m=2 eta, C=1, L=0 and delta=1, including rank n. For each nonzero initial vector, the same objective admits the displayed actual-gradient BFGS history with identity matrices and the fixed valid constants; its values and iterates converge to zero.

New nonsmooth calibration: the coverage proves the complete mixed-ridge certificate for every positive sublevel height, separately from the explicit history on the level 2/3. The actual BFGS history has the printed gradients, matrices, steps and line-search constants, and its least real matrix-spectrum value is exactly 2^(-k), tending to zero; no uniform matrix lower bound is assumed.

New obstruction distinguishing convergence from run existence. The jointly verified finite convex coercive homogeneous gauge has a unique minimizer, but at every printed positive-axis initial point with the identity matrix its search ray has no full-space differentiable weak-Wolfe step for c2<1. The homogeneous convergence theorem remains a conditional statement about admissible runs; this example is not nonoptimal stagnation after reaching the nonsmooth minimizer.

The existing three-quadratic objective now has its actual-run witness stated in the article. For every differentiable initial point below 1/100, every SPD initial matrix and every valid constant pair, the coverage combines the existing existence theorem with the explicit-basin convergence theorem; a separate equality checks the displayed start's value 1001/10^6.

The previously formalized existence theorem is stated with its full assumptions: finite convexity, a lower bound and countably many full-space nondifferentiability parameters on each line through a differentiability point. It supplies a strictly Armijo/weak-Wolfe differentiable step at any nonstationary point, and an infinite run from prescribed differentiable initial data when every such point has nonzero gradient. It does not assert that a specified search implementation finds the steps.

The new positive-parameter two-quadratic family jointly satisfies the literal planar hypotheses on every positive compact sublevel and the finite-max nondegeneracy conditions at its unique minimizer. The coverage explicitly unfolds the geometric records, includes the straight-switch case a=c, and combines universal admissible-run convergence with existence for every prescribed differentiable start, SPD matrix and valid line-search pair.

The mixed certificate's displayed field and constants are the exact fields of the constructed BandCertificate. The coverage supplies the article's nonnegative C requirement in addition to the native structure and quantifies over every positive sublevel height and positive band.
